Instead, it has been transformed into a purely human name, reflecting the successful assimilation of diverse cultural influences into the broader Christian tradition.

The name's origins can serve as a reminder of the power and the reach of God, especially in the face of ancient beliefs and practices that seemed insurmountable. The name may also offer a lesson in redemption, demonstrating how the Christian faith can reclaim and transform even the most unlikely names and symbols. Additionally, some individuals may find personal spiritual meaning in the name, attaching significance to the name's historical derivation or the story of Daniel and Bel in the Bible.
